mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the chest to the lungs was most worthwhile: the pressure comparison explains how chest movement draws air in.

leastWorthwhile.text: The required assembly order for the lining and capillary mesh was initially unclear; fitting the lining directly into the named slot seemed plausible.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the lining and capillary mesh had to be joined before the exchange surface could be fitted to the air route.

arbitrary.text: Attaching the pleural membranes to the chest first felt somewhat arbitrary because their description showed a lung side as well as a chest side. The compatibility feedback made the required order clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the pressure explanation and final circulation diagram made me curious how the remaining body systems connect to cellular work.
